title: Guard direct-prompt operator mutations against cross-origin simple requests before mounting
outcome: Consent, grant, revoke and confirm-revocation adapters enforce the existing operator action trust boundary before parsing or mutation when their routes are mounted.
acceptance: A cross-origin text/plain request to every mutating prompt operator adapter is refused before permission state or durable data changes.
Authorized same-origin operator requests retain their existing authority, consent, freshness and version checks.
Real HTTP behavior tests cover the refusal and authorized path without pinning diagnostic prose.
